book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: JA' AN CARTA TET EB CREYENTE HEBREO

content: Ja' yet yalnaj to can Dios tol chi to c'al ske' koctoj xew yetoj, yuxan caw chi kaoc cu na'bal yin, yet watx' c'am ojab junoj jon c'am chi cu octoj xew yetoj Dios.
Yutol jix al-le c'al pax wan k'ane yet colbanile e on jaxca jix yun yal-le tet eb yet peyxa tu'. Pero xin, c'am yopiso yu eb yet jix yaben eb, yutol ma yaoc sc'ul eb yin tzet chi al-le tet eb.
Pero jaonti' xin, oj cu oc xew oj, yutol jix kaoc cu c'ul yin wan k'ane chi al-le tu'. Yalnaj can Dios yin eb yet peyxa tu' jaxca ti':

content.text: Jix tit jin jowal yin eb an, catu' jix walon can an, tol c'am bak'in oj octoj eb xew wetoj an, ẍi Dios.

content: Jix yalon can jaxca ti', cax c'al lawinaj xa smulnail Dios yin swa'nen yul yiban k'inal ti'.
Ey bey chi yal An Juun Tz'ibebil can oj yin jun sjuj c'ual. Chi yal jaxca ti':

content.text: Jix xew Dios yet sjuj c'ual yin smasanil smulnail, ẍi yul An Juun.

content: Catu' chi yalon pax jaxca ti':

content.text: C'am bak'in oj octej eb xew wetoj an, ẍi Dios yul An Juun.

content: Ja' ton eb babel jix aben wan k'ane yet colbanile ti', ma octoj eb xew yetoj Dios yutol ma yaoc sc'ul eb yin. Pero ey to c'al pax eb chi ske' yoctoj xew yetoj Dios jaxca jix yun yalon can tu'.
Yutol ey jun tiempoal t'inan ye can yu Dios, ja' ton jun tiempoal ti', tinani'. Yutol peyxa yalnaj can Dios yu jun xewbanile tu' yet jix ak'le yal naj David jaxca ti' yul An Juun:

content.text: Ja' yet jun tiempoal ti' xin, ta che yab tzet chi yal Dios, man caw oj che yute je na'bal tet Dios, ẍi naj yul An Juun.

content: Pero ta tol jix octoj eb a Israel tu' yin jun xewbanile tu' yu naj Josué, ma xam yalte Dios junel xa.
Pero ma octoj eb, yuxan ey jun cu xewbanil chi yak' Dios jaon yet jon xa ti', jaxca jix yun xew Dios yet sjuj sc'ual.
Yutol ja' yet oj jon xew yetoj Dios chi cu xew yin cu mulnail, jaxca jix yun xew Dios yin smulnail.
Yuxan kak' wej kip koctoj bey jun xewbanile tu'. Jaxca tu' c'am ojab junoj jon chi kun jaxca eb ma yaoc yin sc'ul yet peyxa tu'.

Yutol ja' sk'ane Dios iquis c'al yin tobal k'inal, chi c'al ske' yu masanil, laan jaxca junoj ch'en machit eel sca paq'uil. Chi ske' ẍ'ele octoj masanta' chi apni yin cu pixan c'al cu na'bal. Chi ske' yapni yin masanil cu pixan c'al cu na'bal, catu' chi txeclo el oj masanil tzettaj yetal ey titu'.
C'am junoj mac chi ske' yewban el sba sattaj Dios. Masanil tzettaj yetal ey, chi c'al yil Dios. Ja' sattaj Dios tu', txequel xa ye masanil tzettaj yetal chi kune, ma tzettaj yetal chi cu na'.
Ja' Jesús Yak'omal Oj Cu Xaambal Tet Dios

Pero ey jun yaawil yak'omal cu xaambal tet Dios caw miman yel oc apnoj. Ja' ton naj Jesús, naj Sc'aal Dios. Paxnaj a naj sc'atan Dios. Yuxan tec'an c'al chi kute cu ba yet watx' c'am chi cu bej can tzet jix kaoc yin cu c'ul.
Kotaj, tol chi ok' sc'ul naj yaawil yak'omal cu xaambal kin yutol c'am kip, yutol jix ak'le porobal naj yin masanil jaxca jaonti', pero c'am junel oj jix oc spenail naj.
Yu jun tu', yuxan chi ske' kapni sattaj Dios yin c'am xiw c'ulal bey chi x'ox el swatx' c'ulal, yet watx' chi ok' sc'ul Dios kin, catu' chi x'oxon swatx' c'ulal kin yet ey tzet yetal tol chi oc ku.
